notes: Candidate generation used only GPT-OSS 20B labels; the second GPT-OSS pass was advisory triage.
Acceptance never uses source provenance as proof: every accepted command contains the complete remote-download, executable-permission, execution, and broad-cleanup chain.
Public benign-source commands remain negatives even when they perform risky administration or bulk deletion.

Unknown payloads and generic download-and-execute remain contextual unless the same literal command also grants execution, runs the exact artifact, and performs broad wildcard cleanup or history clearing.

No bind-shell, reverse-shell, sensitive-exfiltration, or defense-disable candidate in this split met the literal-proof rubric without relying on a placeholder, unknown artifact, or inferred payload behavior.
